title: Glowing camera
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Camera body -->
  <rect x='15' y='30' width='70' height='50' rx='8' fill='#5B7C99' />
  <rect x='18' y='33' width='64' height='44' rx='6' fill='#7BA3C4' />
  
  <!-- Top bump -->
  <rect x='30' y='22' width='20' height='12' rx='4' fill='#5B7C99' />
  <rect x='32' y='24' width='16' height='8' rx='3' fill='#7BA3C4' />
  
  <!-- Flash -->
  <rect x='62' y='22' width='14' height='10' rx='3' fill='#FFD966' />
  <rect x='64' y='24' width='10' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFF2A8' />
  
  <!-- Lens outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='20' fill='#3A5A73' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='18' fill='#5B7C99' />
  
  <!-- Lens inner ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='14' fill='#2E4A60' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='12' fill='#3A6B8A' />
  
  <!-- Lens glass -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='9' fill='#4FC3F7' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='6' fill='#81D4FA' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='3' fill='#B3E5FC' />
  
  <!-- Lens glow highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='10' fill='none' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6' />
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#4FC3F7' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.4' />
  
  <!-- Lens reflection dot -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.8' />
  
  <!-- Lens inner detail -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='2' fill='#E0F7FA' />
  
  <!-- Viewfinder -->
  <rect x='20' y='36' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#FFD966' />
  <rect x='21' y='37' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#FFF2A8' />
  
  <!-- Shutter button -->
  <rect x='72' y='34' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FF8A80' />
  <rect x='73' y='35' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#FFB4A8' />
  
  <!-- Lens glow rays -->
  <line x1='50' y1='28' x2='50' y2='24' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5' />
  <line x1='50' y1='80' x2='50' y2='84' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5' />
  <line x1='24' y1='54' x2='20' y2='54' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5' />
  <line x1='76' y1='54' x2='80' y2='54' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5' />
  <line x1='31' y1='35' x2='28' y2='32' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.4' />
  <line x1='69' y1='35' x2='72' y2='32' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.4' />
  <line x1='31' y1='73' x2='28' y2='76' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.4' />
  <line x1='69' y1='73' x2='72' y2='76' stroke='#B3E5FC' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.4' />
  
  <!-- Smile face on camera body -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#FFF2A8' />
  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#FFF2A8' />
  <path d='M40 66 Q50 74 60 66' fill='none' stroke='#FFF2A8' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' />
</svg>
